Plant Overview - GLE Huron
Glacial Lakes Energy, LLC – Huron was purchased in December 2019. GLE Huron is located on the west side of Huron. GLE Huron currently produces about 33.0 million gallons of ethanol per year as well as modified distillers grains. GLE Huron procures the corn needed to run the facility from Agtegra.
